HealthInterval=10s

Notify=healthy

==> quadlet/roostack-immich-family-server.container
# Generated by Roostack. Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

[Unit]
Description=Roostack immich-family: server
Requires=roostack-immich-family-db-main.service
After=roostack-immich-family-db-main.service
Requires=roostack-immich-family-db-cache.service
After=roostack-immich-family-db-cache.service

[Container]
ContainerName=roostack-immich-family-server
Image=ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:v2.1.0@sha256:72a9b9de6c6abfa7a9c9cdc244ae4d2bd9fea2ae00997f194cbd10aca72ea210
Network=roostack-immich-family.network
PublishPort=127.0.0.1:20003:2283
Environment=DB_DATABASE_NAME=immich_family
Environment=DB_HOSTNAME=roostack-immich-family-db-main
Environment=DB_USERNAME=immich_family
Environment=IMMICH_MACHINE_LEARNING_ENABLED=true
Environment=IMMICH_MACHINE_LEARNING_URL=http://roostack-immich-family-machine-learning:3003
Environment=REDIS_HOSTNAME=roostack-immich-family-db-cache
Secret=roostack-immich-family-db-main-password,type=env,target=DB_PASSWORD
Volume=/srv/roostack/media/immich-family/library:/data
Volume=/srv/roostack/media/immich-family/encoded:/data/encoded-video
Volume=/srv/roostack/media/immich-family/thumbs:/data/thumbs
AddDevice=/dev/dri
GroupAdd=keep-groups
Label=io.roostack.service=immich-family
Label=io.roostack.component=server

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

==> caddy/sites/immich-family.caddy
# Generated by Roostack for service "immich-family". Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

@immich-family-web host family-photos.lab.example.com
handle @immich-family-web {
	vars {
		roostack_name immich-family
		roostack_title "Photos (family)"
		roostack_private yes
	}
	@immich-family-web-external not {
		remote_ip private_ranges 100.64.0.0/12 100.80.0.0/16 100.82.0.0/15 100.84.0.0/14 100.88.0.0/13 100.96.128.0/17 100.97.0.0/16 100.98.0.0/15 100.104.0.0/13 100.112.0.0/12
		not vars roostack_edge yes
	}
	abort @immich-family-web-external
	request_body {
		max_size 50GB
	}
	request_header -Remote-User
	request_header -Remote-Email
	request_header -Remote-Name
	request_header -Remote-Groups
	reverse_proxy 169.254.1.3:20003
}
